text:
**Top pick: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand with Qi2 25W ($129.99)**

Macworld gave it an Editors' Choice badge. I couldn't load the WIRED roundup, so this rests mainly on Macworld's review and the ESR deal page.

- **Charging speeds:** The iPhone charges at up to 25W over Qi2.2. The Apple Watch gets 5W from a module that pulls out of the back. AirPods get 5W from the pad.
- **Adjustability:** Macworld says no rival stands as tall or adjusts as much. It has a weighted hinge and a 160° viewing angle.
- **Travel and power:** It folds down for travel. It includes a 45W adapter plus US, UK and EU plugs.
- **Downside:** It's big and heavy at 399g. Macworld notes the ESR and Kuxiu X40 each weigh 148g.
- **Where to buy:** [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V), [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW), [B&H](https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1960497-REG/satechi_st_q25f31c_ea_3_in_1_foldable_qi2_25w.html), [Walmart](https://www.walmart.com/ip/Satechi-3-in-1-Qi2-Wireless-Charging-Station-25W-Fast-Magnetic-Charger-Foldable-Stand-iPhone-Apple-Watch-AirPods-45W-USB-C-Adapter-Included-Space-Bla/19875453032)

**Lighter, cheaper option: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W (about $82 with a code)**

- **Price:** It lists at $99.99. The code PARTNER18 takes off $17.99, for about $82. The deal page says it tested the code in ESR's cart on Oct 23 and that it expires Dec 31. Check the final price at checkout.
- **Features:** It has a 25W Qi2.2 pad with an active cooling fan, plus an Apple Watch pad and an AirPods pad. A 50W adapter is included.
- **Weight:** It's much lighter than the Satechi, at about 148g.
- **Coverage:** ESR gives a 12-month warranty, or 24 months if you register, and 30-day returns.
- **Caveat:** The full 25W only applies to the iPhone 17 series, iPhone 16 Pro Max and iPhone 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W. Older iPhones get 15W.
- **Cheaper version:** A 15W version costs $79.99 if you don't need the faster speed.
- **Where to buy:** [ESR CryoBoost via Dealectric (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)

**Which to choose**
- Choose the Satechi if you want a bedside or desk stand with an adjustable angle and a bigger build, and you're fine paying more.
- Choose the ESR if you want something lighter and cheaper that still charges at 25W. It also suits travel.

If you tell me which iPhone you have, I can say whether you'd get the full 25W.

**Verdict:** Macworld gave it the Editors' Choice badge. The reviewer says, "There may be smaller and lighter rival 3-in-1 foldable chargers but none stand as tall or are as adjustable as this one."

**Price:** $129.99, the same as the 15W predecessor. It's sold at Amazon, B&H, Best Buy, Satechi, and Walmart.

**Charging speeds:**
- iPhone: up to 25W using Qi2.2
- Apple Watch: 5W from the module that pulls out of the back
- AirPods: 5W from the pad
- Full load is roughly 35W, and the included 45W adapter covers that.

**Pros:**
- Charges an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods together
- Fast Apple Watch charging
- Adjustable charging pad with a weighted hinge and a 160-degree viewing angle
- Folds down for travel
- Includes US, UK, and EU plug adapters and a 45W power adapter

**Cons:**
- Larger and heavier than rivals. It weighs 399g, compared with 148g for the Kuxiu X40 and ESR, and folds to 152 x 90 x 30mm.
- The reviewer notes that smaller, lighter alternatives exist.
